API reference¶

Reading measurement data from CSV files.

ci_course.io.load_measurements(path=None, errors=None)¶

Load a table of measurements from a CSV file.

The sample_id column is treated as a label and is not returned. Every other column is read as a column of floats. Blank cells are recorded as nan, because a missing measurement is not the same as a measurement of zero.

Parameters:

  • path (str or pathlib.Path, optional) – The CSV file to read. Defaults to the sample data bundled with the package.

  • errors (list, optional) – Any row that could not be parsed is appended to this list.

Returns:

A mapping of column name to numpy.ndarray of float.

Return type:

dict

ci_course.io.sample_data_path()¶

Return the path to the sample measurements bundled with the package.

Returns:

The location of sample_measurements.csv.

Return type:

pathlib.Path

Summary statistics for columns of measurements.

ci_course.stats.count_missing(values)¶

Count number of missing values within an array-like object.

Parameters:

values (array_like) – The measurements to count. Missing values should be nan.

Returns:

The number of missing measurements present.

Return type:

int

ci_course.stats.summarise(values)¶

Summarise one column of measurements, ignoring any missing values.

Parameters:

values (array_like) – The measurements to summarise. Missing values should be nan.

Returns:

The number of measurements present, and their mean, standard deviation, minimum and maximum.

Return type:

dict

ci_course.stats.summarise_all(measurements)¶

Summarise every column in a table of measurements.

Parameters:

measurements (dict) – A mapping of column name to measurements, as returned by ci_course.load_measurements().

Returns:

A mapping of column name to the summary of that column.

Return type:

dict

Writing summary reports to disk.

ci_course.report.format_report(summaries)¶

Format a set of column summaries as plain text.

Parameters:

summaries (dict) – A mapping of column name to summary, as returned by ci_course.summarise_all().

Returns:

The formatted report.

Return type:

str

ci_course.report.write_report(summaries, path)¶

Write a report, replacing any report already at path.

The report is written to a temporary file and then moved into place, so that an interrupted run cannot leave a half written report behind.

Parameters:

  • summaries (dict) – A mapping of column name to summary.

  • path (str or pathlib.Path) – Where to write the report.

Returns:

The path the report was written to.

Return type:

pathlib.Path
